phrases.original: nè vorrei che tanto foco terminasse in quel d'amor, in quel d'amor, in quel d'amor, in quel d'amor.
phrases.translation: nor would I want so much fire to end in the fire of love, in the fire of love, in the fire of love, in the fire of love.
